items.headline: BTC firmer near $84k into Monday after defending the $80k area midweek
items.blurb: After breaking the post-Sept-21 ~$83k floor midweek and probing ~$80k Thursday, bitcoin held the weekend near $83k and opened Monday firmer around $83.9k (-2.2% WoW / +8.6% MoM).
items.why_matters: Holding ~$80k kept the monthly uptrend intact; reclaiming and holding ~$83–84k into CPI week is the near-term tell.

items.headline: Friday's BTC ETF print flipped to a small inflow; Monday's flow is next before CPI
items.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs completed Friday at about +$21M after losing ~$485M on Oct 7 and ~$244M on Oct 8 — the heaviest two-day stretch since June. No fresher complete session yet into this Monday rebuild.
items.why_matters: The week was defined by institutional redemptions; Friday's small green print broke the streak and makes Monday's flow the next tell before Wednesday's CPI.

items.headline: Macro calendar: September CPI on Oct 14, then the Oct 27–28 FOMC
items.blurb: Markets head into the week watching Wednesday's inflation print and the late-October Fed meeting, after September's hike and hawkish minutes helped reset rate expectations.
items.why_matters: A hot CPI could revive hike bets and keep pressure on risk assets; a cooler print would ease the liquidity headwind that weighed on ETF demand last week.

items.headline: Futures still in a Deleveraging Sell-Off as of Oct 11
items.blurb: CheckOnChain still shows a Deleveraging Sell-Off: seven-day futures OI down about 3.1% alongside a ~3.4% price drop, with funding mild and positive (~+3.1% ann.).
items.why_matters: Leverage is still being cleared rather than added — less fuel for forced selling than a leveraged washout, but also less dry powder for a fast squeeze.

items.headline: RSDH stays SOL-heavy BULL; Final× trail narrowed to 0.06
items.blurb: Investorius RSDH remains SOL95/BTC5/CASH0 under a BULL macro; fast score bounced to 39 after five easing days. Final× 1.27 vs BTC 1.33 — trail 0.06 (narrowed from 0.07); both Final× were 1.38 a week ago.
items.why_matters: The model is still fully invested and ahead of BTC MoM, but a rough week of SOL lag means it still trails BTC on Final× into CPI week.
